meta.title: Bartosz Dymet · Product engineer, Svelte and TypeScript
meta.description: I design, build and run products: the Zaur mail suite, Szkoły Jogi and more, on open-source Svelte packages I publish.
meta.ogAlt: Bartosz Dymet, frontend engineer, beside the product names Zaur, Szkoły Jogi, thebest.travel, Kino, Kompi and Friendly Festivals.
intro.role: Product engineer · Svelte and TypeScript · Kraków
intro.pitch: I've built websites since 1999. Now I make clean, fast products that still have a human heart inside. I run all of it myself: {products} products, {packages} open-source packages and {templates} Railway templates.
intro.running: Railway counts {running} projects still running from them.
intro.point: Point at a product to light its packages.
work.heading: Products
work.zaur.what: Mail, calendar, video calls and music on one private account, on servers I run.
work.zaur.built.0: JMAP mail client on SvelteKit 3 remote functions, begun on the pre-release: installable, offline, push notifications, calendar, contacts, files, rich compose, multiple accounts.
work.zaur.built.1: Mail is the OpenID Connect provider for Music, Photos and Bartube; sign-up creates real mailboxes through the Stalwart admin API.
work.zaur.built.2: Infrastructure: Stalwart on a VPS under Dokploy, restic backups to a second machine, errors and traces in self-hosted Traceway.
work.zaur.proof.0.v: SvelteKit 3, Svelte 5, TypeScript, JMAP, OpenID Connect
work.zaur.proof.3.v: GitHub Actions deploys; agent conventions in AGENTS.md
work.zaur.proof.4.v: An LLM sorts mail into fixed labels, with a confidence floor, a timeout and a headers-only mode
demo.mail-demo.name: Zaur Mail demo
demo.mail-demo.note: The real client on a sample mailbox. Nothing is sent; it resets every 30 minutes.
demo.signup.name: Zaur sign-up
demo.signup.note: The real sign-up: it creates a working mailbox.
work.szkolyjogi.what: Yoga and pilates schools in Poland: schedules, pass prices, reviews, booking.
work.szkolyjogi.built.0: Public directory in Polish, English and Ukrainian.
work.szkolyjogi.built.1: Panel app for schools: passes, recurring classes, refund rules, VAT split, staff roles.
work.szkolyjogi.built.2: Python scraper that reads school sites, price lists and timetable images with LLMs: schema-bound answers, null instead of guesses, monthly prices computed in code. A read that would shrink a stored schedule below 40% keeps the old classes.
work.szkolyjogi.built.3: A database trigger keeps the scraper off anything a school edited. CI builds both apps as images and deploys them.
work.szkolyjogi.proof.1.v: Benchmarked first; one dropped for inventing 15 classes on an empty page
work.szkolyjogi.proof.2.v: Home-page CLS 0.11 → 0.00 with metric-matched font fallbacks
work.szkolyjogi.proof.3.v: SvelteKit, Svelte 5, Drizzle, Postgres, Better Auth
work.thebest.what: Tour marketplace for Kraków: local guides, live availability, online booking.
work.thebest.built.0: Availability, time slots, pricing and cancellation policies, all from svelte-scheduler.
work.thebest.built.1: Stripe Connect checkout, in test mode until the business side is set up.
work.thebest.built.2: English and Polish, deployed on Railway.
work.thebest.proof.1.v: Repeated Stripe webhooks are ignored once a booking is paid
work.kino.what: Today's showtimes in Polish cinemas, including the studio, culture-centre and film-club screens the big apps miss.
work.kino.proof.1.v: 230 cinemas in 174 towns, crawled every 6 hours
work.kino.proof.2.v: 12 ticketing-site readers; an empty read keeps the last good data. When one site blocked the server, I switched source: 6% of films missed, none wrong
work.kino.proof.3.v: Town and film pages; a panel where cinemas fix their own data
work.kompi.what: Map of drop-off points for e-waste, batteries and bulbs in Poland, filtered by what each takes and how.
work.kompi.proof.1.v: 30,036 collection points in 1,951 cities, scraped by a Python crawler
work.kompi.proof.2.v: MapLibre, address search, nearest points from your location
work.festivals.what: Worldwide directory of open-minded festivals, from ceremony and embodiment gatherings to boutique music and arts.
work.festivals.proof.0.v: A year's calendar by month, a saved plan, lineups, editions, reviews, organiser claims
work.festivals.proof.1.v: An LLM-read fact is kept only if its quote is on the fetched page; nothing publishes without approval

sky.lede: Real sun, moon, stars and weather, drawn on one canvas with zero dependencies. Drag through the day, or change the weather.
sky.noLocation: No location, so the sky stays where it was.
sky.radio: The same sky backs Radio Bartek, my 24/7 station on SubWave, whose AI DJ speaks in a clone of my voice.

ticket.how: This ticket came from the QR code’s address alone: no server and no account.
pkg.zaur-world: A living sky: real sun times, weather, star positions, eclipses and a pixel dinosaur. Zero dependencies.
pkg.svelte-calendar: Themeable Svelte 5 calendar: day, week and month views, agenda, drag-and-drop, timezones, headless API, web component.
pkg.svelte-search: Full-text search for Svelte 5: FTS5, fuzzy matching, geo proximity, autocomplete, Polish locale.
pkg.svelte-i18n: Lightweight Svelte 5 i18n: rune-based locale state, flat JSON messages, URL-locale routing. This page uses it.
pkg.svelte-geometrize: Geometric image placeholders that resolve into the photo as it loads.
pkg.svelte-qr: Zero-dependency QR codes for Svelte 5: a pure TypeScript encoder with SVG output.
pkg.svelte-media: Image upload, processing, and S3-compatible storage for Svelte 5 apps.
pkg.svelte-scheduler: Booking and scheduling logic for Svelte 5: tour slots, pricing, cancellation policies.
pkg.svelte-payments: Provider-agnostic payments for booking apps: Mollie server adapter, Stripe Connect UI.
pkg.svelte-notify: Email notification templates for booking apps.
